seed_origin: local preregistration; author seed not disclosed
bin_identity: VCS cumulative XML coverpoint/bin definitions and crosspoint member tuples; URG HTML is used only for numeric auto-bin fallbacks and covered-total cross-checks
reward: global coverage reports successful-run union deltas; sequence UCB uses 80% mean target-cluster newly-covered bins and 20% mean global newly-covered bins from successful online runs
runtime: simulator CPU seconds; failed attempts included in audit total
walltime: from first submission through last coverage feedback
failure_rule: count every attempt; UVM/VCS/URG/parse failures produce no coverage reward; no retry
policy: author-derived cluster/sequence UCB, MI, dynamic residual, runtime penalty, repeat-eligible ranking and continuous refill loop with target-conditioned online sequence reward

steering.mapping: uncovered AON Timer variable bins to constrained sequence fields; unsupported/cross bins are skipped
steering.target_hit: per-run URG coverage count for the exact selected feature label

compatibility_changes: VCS/URG worker and strict UVM checks
stable cumulative XML bin identity parser with URG total cross-check
preserve raw logs and reject existing output
algorithm_changes: allow consecutive and concurrent selection of the current top-ranked sequence
inner sequence UCB reward is 80% target-cluster new-bin gain and 20% global new-bin gain; initial vectors remain candidate priors only
sequence exploration counts use successful online observations across targets
cluster and sequence UCB observation counts advance only after successful, parsed coverage feedback; every attempt still counts toward the budget
VCS jobs preserve the UCB-selected sequence; steering is applied only to a compatible jump_vseq or prescaler_vseq target, while smoke/stress_all remain ordinary unsteered runs
